summary: Match an entity exact-ID → fuzzy-name fallback, score-gated.

notes: Cascade order matters: exact before fuzzy. This fragment is the query half of a MatchConfig only — it writes nothing until you add the mapping/result_actions block that lands the matched row on your schema fields, which is why produces is empty.
